worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of arccosine is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arccos}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(5x+4\operatorname{arccos}⁡x) \\  & =5+4\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arccos}⁡x) \\  & =5+4(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}) \\  & =5-\frac{4}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
